_meta.source: Transcribed from docs/source/drink-menu-2026-10.pdf and docs/source/food-menu-2026-10.pdf (both marked 'Updated October 23').
verify: Cabernet Sauvignon glass price is not printed clearly (assumed 10 to match the Chardonnay).
October / Oktoberfest specials are seasonal and probably ended; confirm before launch.
Draft list changes often; confirm the current taps.

drinks.title: House-brewed beer
drinks.note: Half pour 9 oz / full pour 16 oz

items.name: Puff Puff Pils
items.description: European pilsner brewed with 100% local grains.

items.name: ¡Chinga La Migra!
items.description: Lager brewed with local barley & corn in solidarity with and support for Columbia County Sanctuary Movement. 15% of draft and can sales go directly to CCSM.

items.name: New York Nectar
items.description: Our flagship IPA brewed with 100% New York grown grains & hops.

items.name: Hoppy American Lager
items.description: Hopped with Nelson, Elani & Loral hops.

items.name: Off Axis
items.description: Hazy pale ale brewed with local grain and hopped with New Zealand Rakau, Motueka and Nelson.

items.name: Festbier
items.description: Modern Oktoberfest lager brewed with 100% local grains. Lighter than a Märzen, but maltier than a pilsner.

items.name: Mountain Märzen
items.description: Traditional Oktoberfest lager, exhibiting rich malt character.

items.name: Sudachi Saison
items.description: Subversive Saison with Japanese sudachi juice & Buddha’s hand.

items.name: Forbidden Fruit
items.description: A tart & quenching sour ale brewed with local black currant juice.

items.name: Cheap Dills
items.description: Tart & briny. Brewed with house pickle brine & pickling spice.

items.name: Subversive Spaghett
items.description: 15 oz of Puff Puff Pils topped with an ounce of Faccia Brutto Aperitivo & a lemon wedge.

items.name: Beer & a ’Berg
items.description: A pint of Festbier or Märzen and a bottle of Underberg.

items.name: The Full Hookup
items.description: A giant Bavarian pretzel + any draft beer (or two half pours).

items.name: Stein & Fill
items.description: Buy the 2026 stein; refills at pint prices all October.

items.name: Hot Apple Cider
items.description: Add a shot of Black Dirt Bourbon +7.

groups.title: Wine
groups.note: 6 oz pour by the glass. Bottles available upon request.

items.name: Classic Gin & Tonic
items.description: Spirits Lab East End Gin, Fever Tree tonic, lime.

items.name: Negroni
items.description: Spirits Lab East End Gin, Method vermouth, Faccia Brutto Aperitivo.

items.name: Moscow Mule
items.description: Albany Distilling vodka, Fever Tree ginger beer, fresh lime.

items.name: Manhattan
items.description: Taconic Founders rye whiskey, Method sweet vermouth, Angostura bitters, Luxardo cherry.

items.name: Margarita
items.description: Steelbound “NY Blanco” (75% grain / 25% agave), triple sec, fresh lime, agave, salt.

items.name: Hot Apple Cider & Bourbon
items.description: Black Dirt bourbon, NY apple cider, cinnamon stick.

items.name: Vodka Soda, Vodka & Cranberry or Vodka Lemonade
Spindrift Sparkling Water
items.description: Grapefruit, lime, raspberry lime, yuzu mandarin.

items.name: Tractor Organic Sodas
items.description: Root beer, cherry cream, kola, kola light.

food.title: Subversive smash burgers
food.intro: Two smashed 3 oz patties of local grass-fed beef from Kilcoyne Farms (Hudson Falls, NY) on a See & Be Bakery (Cairo, NY) milk bun. Served with a side of fries or a house side salad.
food.modifiers: Add bacon +3, tomato +.50, or caramelized onions +.50. Sub GF bun +1.50, vegan bun +1, vegan cheese +1.

items.name: Classic
items.description: Lettuce, American cheese, house-made pickles, Subversive Sauce.

items.name: Mushroom & Swiss
items.description: Arugula, Swiss cheese, sautéed cremini mushrooms, wild mushroom aioli.

items.name: Bacon Barbecue
items.description: Lettuce, bacon, cheddar, frizzled onions, house barbecue sauce.

food.title: Impossible plant-based burgers
food.intro: Two smashed 3 oz patties of Impossible plant-based meat on a See & Be Bakery (Cairo, NY) milk bun. Served with a side of fries or a house side salad.
food.modifiers: Add bacon +3, tomato +.50, or caramelized onions +.50. Sub GF bun +1.50, vegan bun +1, vegan cheese +1.

items.name: Impossible Classic
items.description: Lettuce, American cheese, house-made pickles, Subversive Sauce.

items.name: Impossible Mushroom & Swiss
items.description: Arugula, Swiss cheese, sautéed cremini mushrooms, wild mushroom aioli.

items.name: Impossible Vegan
items.description: Lettuce, plant-based cheddar cheese, house-made pickles, vegan garlic aioli on a vegan potato bun.

food.title: Chicken sandwiches
food.intro: Served with a side of fries or a house side salad.

items.name: Panko Fried Chicken
items.description: House-made pickles, coleslaw, Subversive Sauce on a See & Be milk bun.

items.name: Buffalo Chicken
items.description: Panko breaded chicken breast, buffalo sauce, lettuce, tomato, onion and blue cheese on a See & Be milk bun.

items.name: Grilled Chicken
items.description: Arugula, tomato, red onion, garlic aioli on a See & Be milk bun.

items.name: Lil’ Burger
items.description: One smashed 3 oz patty of local ground beef, pickles, Subversive Sauce, American cheese on a Martin’s potato roll.
items.modifiers: Sub Impossible plant-based meat +2. Add a side of fries or house side salad +4.

items.name: Chicken Wings
items.description: (6) 24-hour house-brined jumbo wings tossed in the sauce of your choice: buffalo, barbecue, sweet Thai chili, lemon pepper or cajun. Served with carrots & celery and a side of house blue cheese or house ranch.

items.name: Chicken Tenders
items.description: (4) lightly breaded chicken tenders served with fries and choice of any dipping sauce.

items.name: Bavarian Pretzel Sticks
items.description: 4 pretzel sticks with house beer cheese + spicy brown mustard.

items.name: Frites
items.description: Large cone of fries, choice of any 2 dipping sauces.

items.name: House Salad
items.description: Mixed greens, cucumber, red onion, tomato, croutons, balsamic vinaigrette.

items.name: Chicken Caesar Salad
items.description: Grilled chicken, romaine, grated parmesan, croutons, liberally tossed in house caesar dressing.*

items.name: Buffalo Chicken Salad
items.description: Panko breaded buffalo chicken breast, romaine lettuce, tomato, red onion, gorgonzola crumbles, ranch dressing.

items.name: Greek Salad
items.description: Bell peppers, tomato, red onion, cucumber, olives, feta and pepperoncini over mixed greens with Greek vinaigrette. Served with toasted pita & a stuffed grape leaf.

items.name: Chicken or Beef
items.description: For a dog or a human.

food.title: House-made dipping sauces
food.note: Sauces à la carte +1.25. Beer cheese à la carte +2.

items.name: Subversive Sauce
items.description: Belgian-inspired house special sauce.

items.name: Samurai Sauce
items.description: Belgian spicy fry sauce.

items.name: Barbecue Sauce
items.description: Sweet and smoky, a little heat.

items.name: Garlic Aioli
items.description: Roasted garlic, lemon.

items.name: Vegan Garlic Aioli
items.description: Roasted garlic, lemon, 100% plant based.

items.name: Wild Mushroom Aioli
items.description: Blend of chanterelle, porcini and shiitake mushrooms.

items.name: Honey Mustard Sauce
items.description: Sweet and spicy.

items.name: Buffalo Sauce
items.description: Tangy and spicy.

items.name: Beer Cheese
items.description: New York Nectar IPA, artisan cheese blend.

items.name: Wing Wednesday Special
items.description: (10) 24-hour house-brined jumbo wings tossed in the sauce of your choice, served with carrots & celery and a side of blue cheese or ranch.

items.name: Rodeo Burger
items.description: Two smashed 3 oz patties of local ground beef topped with cheddar, house barbecue sauce and an onion ring on a See & Be milk bun. Served with fries or a side salad.

items.name: Lil’ Rodeo with fries
items.description: One smashed patty of local ground beef topped with cheddar, house barbecue sauce and an onion ring on a Martin’s potato roll.

items.name: Rodeo Rings
items.description: (8) onion rings à la carte with house buttermilk ranch.

food.title: Oktoberfest specials
food.note: Available the entire month of October.

items.name: The Bavarian Burger
items.description: October burger of the month. Two smashed 3 oz patties of local grass-fed beef, Bavarian mustard, pickles, muenster cheese, caraway kraut. Served with a side of German potato salad, fries or a house side salad.

items.name: Subversive Schnitzel Sandwich
items.description: Hand-breaded pork loin, braised red cabbage, pickles, dijonnaise on a See & Be milk bun. Served with a side of German potato salad, fries or a house side salad.

items.name: Giant Bavarian Pretzel
items.description: With house beer cheese & Bavarian mustard.

items.name: The Full Hookup
items.description: A giant Bavarian pretzel + any draft beer (or two half pours).

notices: If you have a food allergy or intolerance, please notify us.
*Consuming raw or undercooked meats, poultry, seafood, shellfish or eggs may increase your risk of foodborne illness.
